strapiBlog.title: Which A-List Celebrities Live in Dubai?
strapiBlog.short_description: Dubai is not just a playground for the ultra-rich but also a prime destination for A-list celebrities who have chosen this glamorous city as their home.

data.text:
Dubai is not just a playground for the ultra-rich but also a prime destination for A-list celebrities who have chosen this glamorous city as their home. With its luxurious lifestyle, stunning waterfront properties, and tax-free benefits, it’s no wonder that Dubai has become a magnet for Hollywood stars, Bollywood legends, and sporting icons. 

Many celebrities in Dubai have invested in prime real estate, from lavish penthouses to breathtaking villas. Let’s take a look at some of the most famous names who own a slice of Dubai’s extravagant lifestyle.

Key Takeaways

  • Rio Ferdinand relocated to Dubai with his family in 2025.
  • Ronan Keating moved to Dubai with his wife Storm and their children in 2024.
  • Cristiano Ronaldo reportedly purchased a residence at Bulgari Lighthouse on Jumeirah Bay Island in
  • 2023-2024, with land value alone reported at approximately €25 million (roughly AED 108 million).
  • Shah Rukh Khan owns Jannat, a villa on Palm Jumeirah gifted by Nakheel in 2007 and has served as a
  • Dubai Tourism brand ambassador since 2014.
  • Cristiano Ronaldo (granted 2020), Giorgio Armani (2021), and Sanjay Dutt (2021) are among the earliest
  • A-list recipients of the UAE Golden Visa.

Why Celebrities Live in Dubai

Dubai's appeal to Hollywood and Bollywood stars is built on a mix of financial, legal and lifestyle advantages that a few global cities offer. Five factors keep the emirate at the top of the list for celebrity relocations and property purchases.

The Golden Visa

The UAE's 10-year Golden Visa has become the residency route of choice for A-listers. Property investments of AED 2 million or above qualify automatically and the visa extends to spouses and children. Many celebrities have received a golden visa based on their property investment in Dubai.

Tax-Free Ownership

Dubai imposes no personal income tax, no capital gains tax on property resale and no annual property tax for individual owners. For celebrities earning multi-million-dollar incomes and holding multiple homes, the savings compared to residency in the US, UK and most of Europe are substantial.

Privacy Laws

UAE law protects residents from unauthorized photography and paparazzi intrusion. The country has a legal ban on taking pictures of individuals in public without their consent. Lindsay Lohan cited this law as a huge advantage in an interview: "You can't take a picture of someone else if you're in a restaurant. You have to ask the person, which is a big difference." For superstars who are used to constant public exposure, this law is one of the most cited reasons for the move.

Family Safety and Schooling

Dubai consistently ranks among the world's safest cities and its international schools are rated among the region's best. Rio Ferdinand, Ronan Keating, R. Madhavan and Arabella Chi have all cited safety and family life as key drivers of their relocation.

Prime Real Estate and Capital Growth

Dubai's premium residential communities have delivered consistent capital appreciation over the years, with Palm Jumeirah, Jumeirah Bay Island and Emirates Hills leading the ultra-prime segment. For celebrities investing in high-end homes, Dubai combines strong long-term value with the flexibility to sell tax-free. 

Celebrities Who Moved to Dubai in 2024 and 2025

Rio Ferdinand

Former Manchester United and England defender Rio Ferdinand relocated to Dubai with his wife Kate and their four youngest children in 2025. While his exact address is kept private, the family reportedly chose one of Dubai's premium villa communities as their home base. 

His move was preceded by a February 2025 school-tour visit that helped anchor the family's choice of neighbourhood. Ferdinand's Football Escapes business already had strong operational ties in Dubai, making the transition easier for the entire family.

Ronan Keating

Irish singer Ronan Keating moved to Dubai with his wife Storm and their children in late 2024. The family's Dubai base sits within one of the emirate's mid-luxury villa districts, chosen for its combination of privacy, schooling access and community lifestyle.

Keating performed at the Dubai Media City Amphitheatre in November 2025, marking his first major public appearance as a Dubai resident.

Arabella Chi

British model and former Love Island star Arabella Chi moved to Dubai in 2025 with her partner Billy Henty and their newborn daughter, Gigi. Chi's Instagram posts since the move have featured Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah backdrops.

Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah both offer 1- to 4-bed apartment options starting from approximately AED 1.2M. These waterfront neighborhoods are increasingly popular with millennial and Gen Z buyers.

R. Madhavan

Bollywood actor R. Madhavan relocated to Dubai in 2021 with his wife and son, driven by his son’s competitive swimming career and Olympic ambitions. The family chose Dubai for its world-class sports training infrastructure and facilities in and around Jumeirah, Al Wasl, and Dubai Sports City.

Bollywood celebrities have been one of the most consistent sources of demand in Dubai's villa and branded-residence markets over the past five years, with the Palm, Emirates Hills and Downtown Dubai as the most popular choices.

Sushmita Sen

Former Miss Universe and Bollywood actress Sushmita Sen confirmed her Dubai residency in May 2025, with the city now serving as the family headquarters for Renee Jewellers, the luxury jewellery brand launched by her mother, Subhra Sen. 

Sen joins a growing list of Indian A-listers choosing Dubai for its blend of privacy, lifestyle and easy access to India. The emirate consistently ranks as the top destination for investment among Bollywood stars.

Khamzat Chimaev

UFC middleweight champion Khamzat Chimaev has made Dubai his training base and holds full UAE citizenship, a rarer status than the Golden Visa. He trains at TKMMA Fit in Dubai Media City. Media City-adjacent apartment inventory (including Dubai Marina and JBR) remains a popular residential zone for professional athletes based in the city.

Long-Term Celebrity Residents in Dubai

Huda Kattan

Beauty entrepreneur Huda Kattan moved to Dubai in 2006 and built Huda Beauty into a global brand from the city. She remains headquartered in the UAE and reportedly owns a lavish villa in Emirates Hills.
The community continues to be Dubai's most exclusive villa community. Emirates Hills offers an average of AED 3,020 per sq. ft. with rental yields averaging at 6% as per Dubai Land Department (DLD).

Lindsay Lohan

Hollywood actress Lindsay Lohan has been a Dubai resident for more than a decade. She owns a chic apartment in Downtown Dubai, estimated at AED 5 million. Lohan has often spoken about her love for Dubai’s privacy laws and safe environment.

Downtown Dubai remains one of the most popular residential districts for Hollywood residents who prioritize urban connectivity and access to hospitality anchors. Apartment pricing in the community typically starts from approximately AED 2,000 per sq. ft., with premium branded residences at the Burj Khalifa, Address Downtown, and Il Primo commanding significantly higher entry points.

Jo Malone

British fragrance mogul Jo Malone relocated to Dubai in 2021 with her husband and lives in a branded residence. This category, along with serviced apartments, has grown as one of the most popular residential units in Dubai over the past three years, particularly among high-net-worth individuals. 

Vivek Oberoi

Bollywood star Vivek Oberoi moved to Dubai during the COVID-19 pandemic, initially as a short-term relocation that turned into a permanent home for his family. Since then, Oberoi has built one of the most significant Indian-led real estate businesses in the UAE.

As Co-Founder and Managing Director of BNW Developments, Oberoi oversees a portfolio with an AED 32 billion gross development value, spanning luxury residential and commercial projects across Dubai and Ras Al Khaimah. 

Which Celebrities Own Homes in Dubai?

Shah Rukh Khan

The King of Bollywood, Shah Rukh Khan, owns a breathtaking villa known as “Jannat,” located in Palm Jumeirah. Shahrukh Khan’s house in Dubai was gifted to him by Nakheel in 2007 and is estimated to be worth over AED 18 million. 
Shah Rukh Khan’s house in Dubai features a private beach, an infinity pool, and a dedicated entertainment zone. SRK frequently visits the city with his family and has been a brand ambassador for Dubai Tourism for years.

David and Victoria Beckham

Football legend David Beckham and his wife, fashion icon Victoria Beckham, own not one but two luxurious properties in Dubai. Their first home is a stunning celebrity house on the Palm Dubai, purchased in 2002 for AED 6.5 million. 

In 2009, Beckham acquired a plush apartment in the iconic Burj Khalifa, reportedly worth AED 15 million.

Michael Schumacher

Formula One legend Michael Schumacher was gifted a private island in The World Islands by Dubai’s ruler, His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, in 2006. Michael Schumacher’s island in Dubai is part of the Antarctica-themed cluster valued at over AED 30 million. 

While Schumacher’s family has kept details private, the island is considered one of the most exclusive real estate assets in Dubai.

Madonna

Queen of Pop Madonna invested in an exclusive retreat in The World Islands, specifically in the Lebanon Island cluster. This AED 60 million mansion is reportedly her sanctuary whenever she visits the Middle East. The property features private beach access and panoramic views of the Dubai skyline.

Cristiano Ronaldo

Football legend Cristiano Ronaldo received the UAE Golden Visa in 2020, one of the earliest athletes granted the 10-year residency. Ronaldo reportedly acquired a residence at Bulgari Lighthouse on Jumeirah Bay Island, an ultra-exclusive Meraas development consisting of only eight villas.

Giorgio Armani

Luxury fashion mogul Giorgio Armani was granted the UAE Golden Visa in 2021. He owns a penthouse in Burj Khalifa, reportedly worth AED 50 million. His Dubai residence is an extension of the Armani Hotel, offering top-tier luxury services and breathtaking city skyline views.

Armani’s involvement with the city extends beyond his residence through the design collaboration with Emaar Properties, which produced Armani Hotel Dubai and Armani Residences at the Burj Khalifa. Armani Residences at Burj Khalifa remain one of Dubai's most consistently traded branded residences on the secondary market.

Will Smith

Hollywood superstar Will Smith owns a luxurious property in Dubai, where he frequently visits for business and leisure. His villa, located in The Hills, is estimated to be worth AED 30 million. Smith has often expressed his admiration for Dubai’s futuristic vision and vibrant culture, making it one of his preferred destinations outside the U.S.

Roger Federer

Swiss tennis legend Roger Federer owns a penthouse at Le Reve, one of Dubai Marina's most prestigious residential towers. The 20-time Grand Slam champion has trained in Dubai for over two decades and remains a fixture at the annual Dubai Duty Free Tennis Championships.

Lindsay Lohan

Hollywood actress Lindsay Lohan has been a Dubai resident since 2016. She owns a chic apartment in Downtown Dubai, estimated at AED 5 million. Lohan has often spoken about her love for Dubai’s privacy laws and safe environment.

Amir Khan

British boxing champion Amir Khan bought a villa in Jumeirah Golf Estates in 2017 for AED 10 million. The property features a private gym, swimming pool, and expansive garden space. Khan often shares glimpses of his Dubai home on social media.

data.answer: Rio Ferdinand, Ronan Keating, Arabella Chi, R. Madhavan, Khamzat Chimaev, Lindsay Lohan, Huda Kattan, Jo Malone, and Yusuf Islam are among the celebrities currently living in Dubai.

faqs.question: Where does Cristiano Ronaldo live in Dubai?

data.answer: Ronaldo reportedly acquired a residence at Bulgari Lighthouse on Jumeirah Bay Island.

faqs.question: Where do most celebrities live in Dubai?

data.answer: Most celebrities in Dubai live in luxurious neighborhoods like Palm Jumeirah, Jumeirah Bay Island, Downtown Dubai, Emirates Hills, Dubai Marina and The World Islands.

data.answer: Celebrity residences in Dubai span a wide price range, trading well above AED 100M to AED 150M approximately.

faqs.question: How many Indian celebrities live in Dubai?

data.answer: Prominent Indian celebrities based in or spending significant time in Dubai include Shah Rukh Khan, R. Madhavan, Sushmita Sen, Sanjay Dutt, Vivek Oberoi, Lara Dutta, and author Chetan Bhagat.

faqs.question: Do celebrities pay tax on property in Dubai?

data.answer: No, Dubai imposes no annual property tax, no capital gains tax on resale, and no personal income tax on rental earnings for individual property owners.
